name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for precision engineering. Growing up near the Jura mountains, he was captivated by the intricate mechanics of the local watchmaking industry, a passion that eventually steered him towards the world of racing. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from ETH Zurich, Jean-Pierre joined a small Formula 3 team, where he quickly rose through the ranks, proving his innate ability to coordinate test drivers and interpret complex data.

As a Test Driver Coordinator, Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous approach and his ability to extract maximum performance from drivers during testing sessions. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where drivers feel comfortable pushing their limits while providing honest feedback. His visionary nature allows him to anticipate potential issues and implement innovative solutions, ensuring that teams are always one step ahead of the competition. Jean-Pierre's distinctive trait is his uncanny ability to detect subtle variations in vehicle behavior, often identifying problems before they become critical.

physical.description: A man of medium build, Jean-Pierre often sports a focused expression and a neatly trimmed goatee.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing his own herbal tea every afternoon, claiming it enhances his focus.
